worldspawn music key of maps/oa_dm5.bsp, the same track oa_dm6 names. The extension is written out, so S_CodecGetSound uses the ogg codec first and, when that fails, strips the extension and retries the remaining codecs as 'music/sonic3.wav' and 'music/sonic3.opus' (ioq3 code/client/snd_codec.c); no pinned OpenArena release ships any of the three, and a missing track is silence, not a failure
